en: Hello there! It's so very nice to finally meet you.
Welcome to the Floravo region!
My name is Willow.
But most people refer to me as the Demon Professor.
Before we go any further, I must ask...
Is this your first adventure?
If you need assistance, I am perfectly capable of providing it.
Floravo is inhabited by both man and the fantastical creatures known as Demons.
The people of Floravo live beside Demons. Living, learning, and growing together.
Some people battle others with Demons, fighting for victor and glory.
Others may seek to deepen their bonds with their Demon partners through competition.
And what exactly do I do?
Well, I conduct research on the ecology of Demons across different environments.
My findings have helped people connect with Demons on a deeper level.
But that's enough about me. Why don't you tell me a little bit about yourself?
What exactly do you look like, and what is your name?
So, \\pn, is your name?
\\pn is quite the fine name.
Well then, the time has come.
Your very own grand adventure is about to unfold.
You are bound to discover countless Demons, and new aspects about yourself.
Now go forth, \\pn!
Be sure to visit my laboratory for a special gift.
